Norm of coexistence was established globally.

Thriving world was teeming with life.

Replenished resources supported human progress rapidly.

Standard of living was extremely high globally.

Globally, the quality of life improved dramatically.

Dramatically, the world became a utopia.

Utopia was achieved through harmony and cooperation.

Cooperation and mutual respect thrived universally.

Universally, the world was at peace.

Legacy of Harambe inspired a new era.

Era of peace and harmony dawned.

Dawned a new age of enlightenment.

Enlightenment brought about a global awakening.

Awakening to the natural world's beauty.

Beauty of nature was cherished universally.

Universally, the world celebrated Harambe's memory.

Memory of Harambe was honored forevermore.

Forevermore, Harambe's spirit lived on.

On Earth, Harambe's legacy continued.

Generations to come revered Harambe.

Symbol of hope and peace forever.
